$doc: Wave S placement map: where each of the 892 canonical settings renders (Concepts/pm7-tools/settings_refresh/placement.json).
Resolution per id: hand-rendered on a surviving plain page (the literal setting('<id>') rows) wins; else the first override rule that matches; else subgroups[cat.sub]; else page_defaults[cat].

Every section names its destination (a manager id or a page id) and, for tabbed managers, the tab. advanced sections render inside the view's single Advanced disclosure; composed sections are rendered by the manager itself (BSD) and are only placed automatically when the manager did not render them.

Rules: ids = exact ids, glob = fnmatch on the full id. The builder (settings_refresh_source.validate_placement) asserts every rule hits, every id resolves exactly once, destinations and tabs exist in the manager files, and no inline action row is check-labelled.
